### Working Weary or Working With the Lord?
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-feb-6-2010-11625886.html
Passage: Exodus 40:16, 33
Points:
- Modern life constantly drives people toward busyness, overwork, and exhaustion.
- Moses faced no panic or chaotic burden when erecting the tabernacle because he followed the Lord's instructions precisely.
- God provided all necessary blueprints, resources, and gifted artisans to complete the assignment.
- Striving outside of God's guidance leads to frustration and spiritual burnout.
- Believers should invite the Lord into their daily schedules and let Him lead their work.

### Bible Pathway - Jan. 31, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-jan-31-2010-11625604.html
Passage: Exodus 40:20
Points:
- Moses placed the tablets of the Testimony into the ark and covered them with the mercy seat inside the Most Holy Place.
- The Ten Commandments revealed humanity's guilt under the Law, while the mercy seat symbolized covering and forgiveness.
- The ancient high priest entered this sacred room with sacrificial blood to make atonement for the people.
- Christ fulfilled this sanctuary type by entering once for all with His own blood to secure eternal redemption.
- Believers are called to meditate on God's Word continually and surrender obediently to His will.
